title: Flying Saucer Segments
statementMd:
An expedition group flew from planet ACM-1 to Earth in order to study the bipedal species (its representatives don't even have antennas on their heads!).

The flying saucer, on which the brave pioneers set off, consists of three sections. These sections are connected by a chain: the 1-st section is adjacent only to the 2-nd one, the 2-nd one — to the 1-st and the 3-rd ones, the 3-rd one — only to the 2-nd one. The transitions are possible only between the adjacent sections.

The spacecraft team consists of $*n*$ aliens. Each of them is given a rank — an integer from $1$ to $*n*$. The ranks of all astronauts are distinct. The rules established on the Saucer, state that an alien may move from section $*a*$ to section $*b*$ only if it is senior in rank to all aliens who are in the segments $*a*$ and $*b*$ (besides, the segments $*a*$ and $*b*$ are of course required to be adjacent). Any alien requires exactly $1$ minute to make a move. Besides, safety regulations require that no more than one alien moved at the same minute along the ship.

Alien $*A*$ is senior in rank to alien $*B*$, if the number indicating rank $*A*$, is more than the corresponding number for $*B*$.

At the moment the whole saucer team is in the 3-rd segment. They all need to move to the 1-st segment. One member of the crew, the alien with the identification number CFR-140, decided to calculate the minimum time (in minutes) they will need to perform this task.

Help CFR-140, figure out the minimum time (in minutes) that all the astronauts will need to move from the 3-rd segment to the 1-st one. Since this number can be rather large, count it modulo $*m*$.

## Input

The first line contains two space-separated integers: $*n*$ and $*m*$ $(1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9})$ — the number of aliens on the saucer and the number, modulo which you should print the answer, correspondingly.

## Output

Print a single number — the answer to the problem modulo $*m*$.

## Note

In the first sample the only crew member moves from segment 3 to segment 2, and then from segment 2 to segment 1 without any problems. Thus, the whole moving will take two minutes.

statementZhMd:
一支探险队从 ACM-1 行星飞往地球，目的是研究双足物种（它们的代表头上甚至连触角都没有！）。

勇敢的先驱者们乘坐的飞碟由三个舱段组成。这些舱段通过链式结构相连：第 1 个舱段只与第 2 个舱段相邻，第 2 个舱段与第 1 个和第 3 个舱段相邻，第 3 个舱段只与第 2 个舱段相邻。只有相邻舱段之间才能进行移动。

飞船上的乘员由 $*n*$ 名外星人组成。每名外星人都被赋予了一个从 $1$ 到 $*n*$ 的整数军衔，且所有宇航员的军衔各不相同。飞碟上的规定指出：只有当一名外星人的军衔高于位于舱段 $*a*$ 和舱段 $*b*$ 中的所有外星人时，他才能从舱段 $*a*$ 移动到舱段 $*b*$（当然，舱段 $*a*$ 和舱段 $*b*$ 还必须相邻）。每名外星人完成一次移动恰好需要 $1$ 分钟。此外，安全规定要求同一分钟内沿飞船移动的外星人不得超过一名。

如果外星人 $*A*$ 的军衔数字大于外星人 $*B*$ 的对应数字，则称外星人 $*A*$ 的军衔高于外星人 $*B*$。

目前，所有飞船乘员都在第 3 个舱段。他们需要全部移动到第 1 个舱段。乘员中的一员——编号为 CFR-140 的外星人——决定计算完成这一任务所需的最短时间（分钟数）。

请帮助 CFR-140 求出所有宇航员从第 3 个舱段移动到第 1 个舱段所需的最短时间（分钟数）。由于这个数可能很大，请输出它对 $*m*$ 取模后的结果。

## 输入格式

第一行包含两个用空格分隔的整数：$*n*$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*, *m* ≤ 10^{9}$），分别表示飞碟上的外星人数，以及你需要用来对答案取模的数。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即答案对 $*m*$ 取模后的结果。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，唯一的乘员先从第 3 个舱段移动到第 2 个舱段，然后从第 2 个舱段移动到第 1 个舱段，整个过程没有遇到任何问题。因此，完成全部移动需要 2 分钟。

为了简要描述第二个样例中的移动，我们使用数值 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4c7c8e716067e9c6251e8ca82a4ca7fde74fbacb.png)，它表示军衔为 $*i*$ 的外星人从当前所在的舱段移动到编号为 $*j*$ 的舱段。使用这些数值，我们将第二个样例中的舱段移动描述为：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1adb8798904e42944c35bd49feff02db6c3ea10b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/954e2f634474269f53df1edbf2e7b214d8a2611c.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be5f59dacfc6f7ded42f8f260c7b7aedf17ec1f0.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4fd9e68a9c6a277942eb188291d6d2744ea21d3.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1adb8798904e42944c35bd49feff02db6c3ea10b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/b73a9870e1b41a5e048c3ab3e3fd4b92c336c9ec.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be5f59dacfc6f7ded42f8f260c7b7aedf17ec1f0.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/954e2f634474269f53df1edbf2e7b214d8a2611c.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1adb8798904e42944c35bd49feff02db6c3ea10b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/49b1ffd4dcd2e0da0acec04559e0c3efc7854b07.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be5f59dacfc6f7ded42f8f260c7b7aedf17ec1f0.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/ef8b3f32ee76c86f57fa63f7251fa290642f17f8.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1adb8798904e42944c35bd49feff02db6c3ea10b.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/954e2f634474269f53df1edbf2e7b214d8a2611c.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/be5f59dacfc6f7ded42f8f260c7b7aedf17ec1f0.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/d4fd9e68a9c6a277942eb188291d6d2744ea21d3.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7668900e59f9bc3ccc78b0a77dca322fcb02fa04.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/1adb8798904e42944c35bd49feff02db6c3ea10b.png)。总计：外星人需要进行 26 次移动。$26$ 除以 $8$ 的余数为 $2$，因此该测试的答案为 $2$。
